context: Tests whether the agent produces a PR description with the correct two-section body structure (TL;DR and Details), setext underlines with the exact prescribed dash counts, prose-only formatting, active voice, and a well-formed subject line — all without the task hinting at any of these requirements.

checklist.name: TL;DR section present
checklist.description: pr-description.md contains a section header with the exact text 'TL;DR' (case-sensitive)

checklist.name: TL;DR setext underline
checklist.description: The 'TL;DR' header in pr-description.md is followed immediately by a line containing exactly five dashes (-----) and nothing else

checklist.name: Details section present
checklist.description: pr-description.md contains a section header with the exact text 'Details' (case-sensitive)

checklist.name: Details setext underline
checklist.description: The 'Details' header in pr-description.md is followed immediately by a line containing exactly seven dashes (-------) and nothing else

checklist.name: Exactly two sections
checklist.description: pr-description.md contains no section headers other than 'TL;DR' and 'Details' — no ATX headings (lines starting with #) and no other setext underlined headers appear in the body

checklist.name: Prose only
checklist.description: The body of pr-description.md contains no bullet points (lines starting with -, *, or •) and no numbered list items (lines starting with a digit followed by a period or parenthesis)

checklist.name: No forbidden phrases
checklist.description: pr-description.md does NOT contain any of the following phrases (case-insensitive): 'this PR', 'this change', 'this commit', 'this update', 'the fix', 'the solution', 'the change'

checklist.name: Active voice
checklist.description: The body in pr-description.md contains no passive-voice constructions — specifically no instances of 'was [verb]ed', 'were [verb]ed', 'is [verb]ed by', or 'are [verb]ed by'

checklist.name: Subject line length
checklist.description: The first line of pr-description.md (the subject line) is 50 characters or fewer

checklist.name: Subject no trailing punctuation
checklist.description: The subject line (first line of pr-description.md) does NOT end with a period, comma, exclamation mark, or question mark

checklist.name: Backticks for identifiers
checklist.description: pr-description.md uses backtick-delimited inline code for at least one technical identifier such as a function name, file path, environment variable, or command
